gen-gf-reggae-one-fs-rowan: Rowan, a serif, reads friendly and literary, with generously opened curves and hairlines about half the weight of its stems. Reggae One's spaced-out, watercolor-brushed letters are the standout, for a couple of lines.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One is a classic serif that reads at a leisurely walk, with joins no thinner than its stems. And Revalia's widely spaced, tall letters keep that unhurried pace going down the page.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-hepta-slab: Big, loose, a bit swaggering: Revalia strides across the top with its open-tailed g. And Hepta Slab, a serif drawn in uniform strokes with open counters, stretches out beneath it with no weight shifts.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-kiwi-maru: Loud meets pen-drawn: Revalia strides wide, bold and relaxed above Kiwi Maru. And Kiwi Maru's round-tipped-pen letters, with generous spacing and terminals stopping far from the stem, are the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Slack rope, wide stride: Revalia and Padyakke Expanded One both take their time. Revalia is best at bold, expressive statements up top, while the serif body is best at keeping every stroke uniform and wide-mouthed.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart, with a pipe-cleaner feel and open counters leading outward. But Revalia's lowercase stands noticeably taller than its partner's, so the step down is obvious.
gen-gf-ribeye-fs-rowan: Closed-up and commanding: nearly sealed curves give Ribeye a lingering, one-beat-per-letter look. And Rowan's open curves and hairlines at half the weight of its stems make for a friendly, literary read that fits brief text.
gen-gf-ribeye-marrow-fs-rowan: Friendly and literary, Rowan keeps its curves generous and its thin strokes light. And Ribeye Marrow's loosely strung, pinched-shut curls give the pair its edge, best left to a line or two.
gen-gf-rock-3d-fs-rowan: Tiny sealed pockets give Rock 3D a slow, softly textured look. Rowan, a friendly literary serif with generous openings, is an open counterweight to those pockets, though lengthy text isn't its job.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-amulya: Schoolbell looks hand-drawn, with a tight letterfit and an e that opens up instead of closing its eye. Amulya's modern sans-serif curves stay generous, a crisp foil for brief lines.
